notes.title: Fitz the Fox Winter Update
notes.content:
Hey guys Fitz the Fox just got a little update with a really cool feature that I think we've needed for a while. In this update we've added checkpoints! So now the game feels a bit more fair. 

We've also added a few fixes with the color mode and have set the groundwork for some more cool things in the future.

Enjoy and thanks for play :)

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Just some more minor fixes. I noticed some people didn't know there were two sets of last levels so I added a "Pick a Fox" text to help show that option more. You'll see it in the last cutscene before finishing the game.

notes.title: small update
notes.content:
really small...
Some of you guys were having problems with the unlockable colormode. It should be fixed now but let me know if you still have problems. 

If you managed to turn color mode on you'll have it unlocked for you automaticly and you can find the setting in your options.
